name: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport Company Limited
summary: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport Company Limited manages and operates Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport in China. The company provides aviation services for aircraft, passengers, cargo, and mail, including aircraft takeoff, landing and parking, passenger services, security checks, and ground support services. It also offers commercial venue leasing, franchising services, ground transportation services, advertising services, hotel services, and other aviation extension services. Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport Company Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
